name: Tavily
tagline: Web search, extraction, mapping, and crawling built for agents
description: Tavily's hosted MCP server provides real-time web search plus page extraction, site mapping, and web crawling tools through the Tavily API.

install.notes: OAuth is handled during setup. You can also pass a Tavily API key via the ?tavilyApiKey=<key> query parameter or an Authorization: Bearer <key> header.
